instruction: Create a script that checks internet connectivity and logs the result
output:
#!/bin/bash
LOG=/var/log/netcheck.log
if ping -c 1 -W 2 1.1.1.1 > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "$(date) UP" >> "$LOG"
else
  echo "$(date) DOWN" >> "$LOG"
fi

instruction: Create a script that backs up the current IP configuration
output:
#!/bin/bash
OUT=/root/net-backup-$(date +%F).txt
ip addr show > "$OUT"
ip route show >> "$OUT"
resolvectl status >> "$OUT"

instruction: Write a script that restarts eth0
output:

sudo ip link set eth0 down
sleep 2
sudo ip link set eth0 up
